paper_title: The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful   Communication Datasets
caption: Conceptualized and operationalized targets by year along with the distribution of datasets. Targeted refers to datasets that have explicitly mentioned at least one target in their construct definition (i.e., in the conceptualization phase) and/or publications in which the authors define concrete measures to ensure and validate the presence of at least one target group in the data (i.e., in the operationalization phase). Untargeted refers to all other datasets that do not meet these two criteria. Note that the data for 2022 is only partially available (as described in our Methods and Data Section).
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of datasets across different years, categorized into targeted and untargeted datasets. The horizontal axis represents the years from 2012 to 2022, while the vertical axis represents the number of datasets, labeled with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 160, marked with intervals of 20. The chart features two categories of bars: 'Untargeted' and 'Targeted', represented by blue and orange colors, respectively. In 2012, both categories have approximately 1 dataset. The 'Untargeted' category increases gradually, with around 2, 3, 5, and 15 datasets in 2013, 2014, 2015, and 2016. A significant increase is observed from 2017 onwards, with approximately 15, 25, 45, 50, and 65 datasets in 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, and 2021, respectively. The 'Targeted' category also increases, with approximately 1, 2, 1, 5, 20, 35, 65, and 155 datasets in 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, and 2021. The 'Untargeted' and 'Targeted' datasets are grouped by year. The bars are sorted chronologically by year. No bars are visually emphasized. Notably, the data for 2022 is only partially available and appears to show around 35 'Targeted' datasets and some 'Untargeted' datasets, but the exact values are not clearly shown.
